title: Finding purpose: Integrated latent profile and machine learning analyses identify purpose in life as an important predictor of high-functioning recovery after alcohol treatment.
summary: A secondary Project MATCH analysis uses recursive partitioning and random forests to identify modestly predictive three-year alcohol-recovery profiles from end-of-treatment measures. Evidence is exploratory and internally validated only.
ai_technology: Recursive partitioning and random forests operate on 28 end-of-treatment biopsychosocial predictors to form/predict three-year recovery profiles and rank predictors.
